rows.source: Bretscher, Kodama-Namba, Busch, Murray, Lagnado & de Bono 2011 Neuron 69:1099 (PMC3115024), Results and Fig. 3: BAG Cameleon responses to 0% to x% CO2 steps, x = 0.25, 1, 3, 5, 10%
rows.source_quote: The excitability threshold of BAG was below 0.25% CO 2 . A plot of mean fluorescence ratio change against percent (%) CO 2 suggests that BAG reaches half-maximal activity at ∼2.9% CO 2

rows.mechanism_name: Temperature: AFD GCY-8/18/23 cGMP cascade around T*
rows.label: measured
rows.source: Ramot, MacInnis & Goodman 2008 Nat Neurosci 11:908 (PMC2587641), AFD whole-cell patch clamp: with BAPTA in the pipette T* = 20 +- 1 C in worms cultivated at 20 C (n = 4); with EGTA, T* tracked the holding temperature of the last ~15 min instead (adaptation time constants 244 s warming, 518 s cooling). Calcium imaging: the AFD threshold follows the cultivation temperature (Clark, Biron, Sengupta & Samuel 2006 J Neurosci 26:7444, PMC6674189; Kimura et al. 2004)

rows.audit_trail: gait_features uses one speed cut and no minimum duration; Yemini 2013 uses two cuts (5% and 2.5% of length per second) and a 0.5 s minimum [accepted: offline readout; its paused fraction counts Yemini's ambiguous band (2.5-5% L/s) and sub-0.5 s pauses as paused, so compare paused fractions with Yemini's only with that in mind]
